column2: finalization must inspect the daemon-owned `.result.env` and branch on `bgjob_rc` before requiring merge or status artifacts.
crash finalization must not retry another tier when the crashed lane already advanced `head` with a salvage commit.
crash recovery must fail closed on uncommitted drift or unverified changes before launching the next fixer tier.
launch context plus stdout and stderr tails must be composed, redacted, and truncated as one bounded payload.
